_about: What changed, newest first. The daily refresh adds one entry per run (see tools/DAILY-LOADOUTS.md), even when nothing changed, so the home page can show when the site was last checked. area is one of Loadouts, Warzone, Rules, Maps, Site. Keep each line short and plain. Keep the newest 30 entries.

items.text: Hyeon Burst on wzstats.gg: new build with the Hyeon Auto Apex, Locus PX3 Canted optic, 60 Round Drum Mag and HVY-80 Stockpad. The Hyperburst Apex, Cronen R808, rear grip and high velocity rounds are gone.
CSG-35 on wzstats.gg: the Matuzek Fire-Pro rear grip replaces the CQC Stop underbarrel.
Cronen Squall: wzstats.gg now runs a Locus PX3 Canted optic, FSS Fireline Grip and 60 Round Drum, so the two sites no longer agree and both builds are shown.
No weapon changed tier. All 30 weapons were re-read on both sites today.
